description: Oil-immersed power transformer whose insulating oil and cellulose paper condition is monitored through dissolved gas analysis (DGA), oil quality tests, temperatures and electrical loading. Health is assessed against IEEE C57.104 and IEC 60599 fault classes (PD, D1, D2, T1-T3).

iot_sensors.name: acetylene
iot_sensors.description: Dissolved acetylene (C2H2) in oil, ppm; key gas for arcing and high-energy discharge

iot_sensors.name: ati
iot_sensors.description: Ambient temperature indicator reading

iot_sensors.name: co
iot_sensors.description: Dissolved carbon monoxide in oil, ppm; indicates cellulose (paper) involvement

iot_sensors.name: co2
iot_sensors.description: Dissolved carbon dioxide in oil, ppm; used in the CO2/CO ratio for paper involvement

iot_sensors.name: dbds
iot_sensors.description: Dibenzyl disulfide content in oil, an oil quality/corrosive sulfur indicator

iot_sensors.name: dielectric_rigidity
iot_sensors.description: Dielectric breakdown voltage (dielectric strength) of the insulating oil

iot_sensors.name: ethane
iot_sensors.description: Dissolved ethane (C2H6) in oil, ppm; typical of low-temperature (T1) oil overheating

iot_sensors.name: ethylene
iot_sensors.description: Dissolved ethylene (C2H4) in oil, ppm; key gas for hot oil and higher-temperature thermal faults

iot_sensors.name: hydrogen
iot_sensors.description: Dissolved hydrogen (H2) in oil, ppm; key gas for partial discharge

iot_sensors.name: il1
iot_sensors.description: Line current on phase 1

iot_sensors.name: il2
iot_sensors.description: Line current on phase 2

iot_sensors.name: il3
iot_sensors.description: Line current on phase 3

iot_sensors.name: interfacial_v
iot_sensors.description: Interfacial tension of the insulating oil, an oil ageing/contamination indicator

iot_sensors.name: inut
iot_sensors.description: Neutral current

iot_sensors.name: methane
iot_sensors.description: Dissolved methane (CH4) in oil, ppm; used in the Rogers/IEC ratios and the Duval triangle

iot_sensors.name: nitrogen
iot_sensors.description: Dissolved nitrogen in oil (non-combustible, excluded from TDCG)

iot_sensors.name: oti
iot_sensors.description: Oil temperature indicator (top-oil temperature)

iot_sensors.name: oti_a
iot_sensors.description: Oil temperature indicator alarm-related reading

iot_sensors.name: oti_t
iot_sensors.description: Oil temperature indicator trip-related reading

iot_sensors.name: oxygen
iot_sensors.description: Dissolved oxygen in oil (non-combustible, excluded from TDCG); relates to oxidation and air ingress

iot_sensors.name: power_factor
iot_sensors.description: Power factor measurement associated with the transformer

iot_sensors.name: rated_mva
iot_sensors.description: Transformer rated power (MVA), used for load-versus-rating assessment

iot_sensors.name: vl1
iot_sensors.description: Phase 1 voltage

iot_sensors.name: vl12
iot_sensors.description: Line-to-line voltage between phases 1 and 2

iot_sensors.name: vl2
iot_sensors.description: Phase 2 voltage

iot_sensors.name: vl23
iot_sensors.description: Line-to-line voltage between phases 2 and 3

iot_sensors.name: vl3
iot_sensors.description: Phase 3 voltage

iot_sensors.name: vl31
iot_sensors.description: Line-to-line voltage between phases 3 and 1

iot_sensors.name: water_content
iot_sensors.description: Moisture content in the insulating oil

iot_sensors.name: wti
iot_sensors.description: Winding temperature indicator (winding hot-spot temperature)

failure_modes.description: IEC 60599 class PD; H2-dominant gassing that can progress to dielectric breakdown
T1-T3 oil overheating; CH4/C2H6 at low temperature and rising C2H4 at higher temperature
Overheated conductors or core joints; the winding is the dominant failure location (~38% of major failures), with CO rising when paper is involved
IEC D1 low-energy discharge; H2 and CH4 with trace C2H2
IEC D2 arcing (~700-1800 °C) with large C2H2 increase; risk of fire and tank rupture
OLTC contact coking and pitting that degrades contacts and can cause local heating
Moisture and contaminants lower dielectric strength and interfacial tension and accelerate paper ageing
Paper degradation indicated by high CO/CO2; irreversible loss of insulation life
Reduced breakdown voltage and oil quality, which increases the risk of discharge and insulation failure

iot.name: sites
iot.reason: Identify the site (MAIN) hosting the transformer

iot.name: installed_sensors
iot.reason: List the DGA, temperature and electrical channels available

iot.name: stream_extent
iot.reason: Confirm the data window (2024-01-15 to 2024-01-19) before analysis

iot.name: history
iot.reason: Retrieve gas and temperature trends needed for rate-based DGA assessment

iot.name: latest_reading
iot.reason: Get the latest oil sample values for single-gas limit checks

iot.name: sensor_stats
iot.reason: Summarize gas levels, loading and temperatures over the window

fmsr.name: interpret_dga
fmsr.reason: Apply key-gas, ratio, Duval and TDCG methods to classify faults

fmsr.name: assess_winding_temperature
fmsr.reason: Evaluate WTI/OTI for thermal stress on windings and oil

fmsr.name: assess_load_profile
fmsr.reason: Relate phase currents and rated MVA to overload and thermal gassing

fmsr.name: predict_health_index
fmsr.reason: Combine DGA, oil quality and thermal data into a health index for prioritization

tsfm.name: data_quality
tsfm.reason: Check gaps in sparse oil-sample and sensor series

tsfm.name: profile_series
tsfm.reason: Characterize gas growth trends, since rate matters more than snapshots

tsfm.name: find_models
tsfm.reason: Select forecasting/anomaly models for gas and temperature trends

tsfm.name: run_recipe
tsfm.reason: Execute forecasting or anomaly detection on DGA channels

wo.name: list_workorders
wo.reason: Review maintenance history, including oil treatment that masks gas levels

wo.name: get_failure_codes
wo.reason: Code work orders consistently with transformer fault classes

wo.name: generate_work_order
wo.reason: Raise resampling, oil test, outage or inspection work per IEEE condition

wo.name: assign_technician
wo.reason: Dispatch qualified staff for oil sampling and electrical testing

wo.name: get_schedule_calendar
wo.reason: Plan outage windows and DGA sampling intervals

operator_tasks: List the gases in Transformer 1's latest oil sample at site MAIN that exceed the IEEE C57.104 Condition 1 single-gas limits.
Interpret the dissolved gas readings for Transformer 1 between 2024-01-15 and 2024-01-19 and tell me which IEC 60599 fault class applies and whether the paper is involved.
Compute TDCG for Transformer 1 from the latest reading, excluding CO2, O2 and N2, and state which IEEE condition level it falls in.
Check whether hydrogen and ethylene on Transformer 1 increased over the available window and estimate the daily gas rate.
Assess Transformer 1's winding and top-oil temperatures against the phase load currents and rated MVA to see whether thermal gassing correlates with load.
Review water content, dielectric rigidity and interfacial tension on Transformer 1 to determine whether moisture ingress or oil degradation is occurring.
Check for data gaps in the Transformer 1 acetylene and CO series before running a trend analysis.
manager_tasks: Summarize Transformer 1's DGA condition and health index and recommend the next resampling interval per IEEE C57.104.
Transformer 1 shows rising CO with thermal gases; create a work order for an oil sample retest and an insulation check, and assign a technician.
Review Transformer 1's work order history for recent oil filtration or regeneration that could mask gas levels, and schedule a re-baseline sample.
If Transformer 1 reaches Condition 3, plan an outage window, notify the manufacturer, and raise the DGA sampling frequency to monthly.
Rank the failure modes for Transformer 1 by current sensor evidence to prioritize the maintenance budget.
